***ORDER BY FORMULA** ( *aTable* : Table ; { ...(*formula* : Expression {; *order* : >, <})} )

**ORDER BY FORMULA** sorts (reorders) the records of the current selection of *aTable* for the current process.

**ORDER BY** ( {*aTable* : Table} {; ...(*aField* : Field {; *order* : >, <}) } {; *} )

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ORDER%20BY&class=ORDER%20BY&member=)

**Table** ( *tableNum* : Integer ) : Pointer  
**Table** ( *tablePtr* : Pointer ) : Integer  
**Table** ( *fieldPtr* : Pointer ) : Integer

* If you pass a table number in *tableNum*, Table returns a pointer to the table.
* If you pass a table pointer in *tablePtr*, Table returns the table number of the table.
* If you pass a field pointer in *fieldPtr*, Table returns the table number of the field.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Table&class=Table&member=)

**OB SET** ( *object* : Object ; *property* : Text ; *value* : Expression {; ...(*property* : Text ; *value* : Expression)} )

The **OB SET** command creates or modifies one or more *property*/*value* pairs in the language object designated by the *object* parameter.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=OB%20SET&class=OB%20SET&member=)

**GRAPH** ( *graphPicture* : Picture ; *graphNumber* : Integer ; *xLabels* : Array {; *...yElements* : Array} )

**QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE** ( {*aTable* : Table ;}{*conjOp* : &, \|, # ;} *objectField* : Field ; *attributePath* : Text ; *queryOp* : Text, >, <, >=, <=, #, =, \|, % ; *value* : Text, Real, Date, Time {; *} )

The SQL EXECUTE command executes an SQL command and binds the result to 4D objects (arrays, variables or fields).

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=SQL%20EXECUTE&class=SQL%20EXECUTE&member=)

returns the class store for available built-in 4D classes

**ABORT PROCESS BY ID** ( *uniqueID* : Integer )

The **ABORT PROCESS BY ID** command stops a specific process on the 4D Server.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ABORT%20PROCESS%20BY%20ID&class=ABORT%20PROCESS%20BY%20ID&member=)

**ABORT**

The **ABORT** command is used from within an error-handling project method installed using the command ON ERR CALL.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ABORT&class=ABORT&member=)

**ACCEPT**

**ACCEPT** performs the same action as if a user had pressed the Enter key. After the form is accepted, the OK system variable is set to 1.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ACCEPT&class=ACCEPT&member=)

**ACCUMULATE** ( {*...data* : any} )

**ACCUMULATE** specifies the fields or variables to be accumulated during a form report performed using PRINT SELECTION.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ACCUMULATE&class=ACCUMULATE&member=)

**ACTIVITY SNAPSHOT** ( *arrActivities* : Object array {; *} )  
**ACTIVITY SNAPSHOT** ( *arrUUID* : Text array ; *arrStart* : Text array ; *arrDuration* : Integer array ; *arrInfo* : Text array {; *arrDetails* : Object array}{; *} )

The **ACTIVITY SNAPSHOT** command returns a single or several arrays describing operations in progress on the 4D data.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ACTIVITY%20SNAPSHOT&class=ACTIVITY%20SNAPSHOT&member=)

**ADD RECORD** ( * )

**ADD TO SET** ( {*aTable* : Table ;} *set* : Text )

ADD TO SET adds the current record of *aTable* to *set*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ADD%20TO%20SET&class=ADD%20TO%20SET&member=)

**ADJUST BLOBS CACHE PRIORITY** ( *aTable* : Table ; *priority* : Integer )

This command is reserved for specific needs.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ADJUST%20BLOBS%20CACHE%20PRIORITY&class=ADJUST%20BLOBS%20CACHE%20PRIORITY&member=)

**ADJUST INDEX CACHE PRIORITY** ( *aField* : Field ; *priority* : Integer )

This command is reserved for specific needs.

**ALERT** ( *message* : Text {; *okButtonTitle* : Text} )

The **ALERT** command displays an alert dialog box composed of a note icon, a message, and an OK button.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ALERT&class=ALERT&member=)

**ALL RECORDS** ({ *aTable* : Table })

ALL RECORDS selects all the records of *aTable* for the current process.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ALL%20RECORDS&class=ALL%20RECORDS&member=)

**APPEND DATA TO PASTEBOARD** ( *dataType* : Text ; *data* : Blob )

The APPEND DATA TO PASTEBOARD command appends to the pasteboard the data contained in the BLOB *data* under the data type specified in *dataType*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=APPEND%20DATA%20TO%20PASTEBOARD&class=APPEND%20DATA%20TO%20PASTEBOARD&member=)

**APPEND MENU ITEM** ( *menu* : Integer, Text ; *itemText* : Text {; *subMenu* : Text {; *process* : Integer}} {; *} )

The **APPEND MENU ITEM** command appends new menu items to the menu whose number or reference is passed in *menu*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=APPEND%20MENU%20ITEM&class=APPEND%20MENU%20ITEM&member=)

**APPEND TO ARRAY** ( *array* : Array ; *value* : Expression )

The APPEND TO ARRAY command adds a new element at the end of *array* and assigns *value* to the element.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=APPEND%20TO%20ARRAY&class=APPEND%20TO%20ARRAY&member=)

**APPEND TO LIST** ( *list* : Integer ; *itemText* : Text ; *itemRef* : Integer {; *sublist* : Integer ; *expanded* : Boolean} )

The **APPEND TO LIST** command appends a new item to the hierarchical list whose list reference number you pass in *list*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=APPEND%20TO%20LIST&class=APPEND%20TO%20LIST&member=)

**APPLY TO SELECTION** ( *aTable* : Table ; *statement* : Expression )

**APPLY TO SELECTION** applies *statement* to each record in the current selection of *aTable*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=APPLY%20TO%20SELECTION&class=APPLY%20TO%20SELECTION&member=)

**ARRAY BLOB** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The **ARRAY BLOB** command creates and/or resizes an array of Blob type elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20BLOB&class=ARRAY%20BLOB&member=)

**ARRAY BOOLEAN** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY BOOLEAN command creates and/or resizes an array of Boolean elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20BOOLEAN&class=ARRAY%20BOOLEAN&member=)

**ARRAY DATE** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY DATE command creates and/or resizes an array of Date elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20DATE&class=ARRAY%20DATE&member=)

**ARRAY INTEGER** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY INTEGER command creates and/or resizes an array of 2-byte Integer-1) (2-byte integer)") elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20INTEGER&class=ARRAY%20INTEGER&member=)

**ARRAY LONGINT** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY LONGINT command creates and/or resizes an array of 4-byte Longint-1 (4-byte Integer)") elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20LONGINT&class=ARRAY%20LONGINT&member=)

**ARRAY OBJECT** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The **ARRAY OBJECT** command creates and/or resizes an array of language Object type elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20OBJECT&class=ARRAY%20OBJECT&member=)

**ARRAY PICTURE** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY PICTURE command creates and/or resizes an array of Picture elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20PICTURE&class=ARRAY%20PICTURE&member=)

**ARRAY POINTER** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The **ARRAY POINTER** command creates or resizes an array of Pointer, table, or field") elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20POINTER&class=ARRAY%20POINTER&member=)

**ARRAY REAL** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY REAL command creates and/or resizes an array of Real") elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20REAL&class=ARRAY%20REAL&member=)

**ARRAY TEXT** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The ARRAY TEXT command creates and/or resizes an array of Text elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20TEXT&class=ARRAY%20TEXT&member=)

**ARRAY TIME** ( *arrayName* : Array ; *size* : Integer {; *size2* : Integer} )

The **ARRAY TIME** command creates and/or resizes an array of Time type elements in memory.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20TIME&class=ARRAY%20TIME&member=)

**ARRAY TO COLLECTION** ( *collection* : Collection ; ...(*array* : Array {; *propertyName* : Text} ))

The **ARRAY TO COLLECTION** command copies one or more *array*(s) into the elements or the *propertyName* values of *collection*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20TO%20COLLECTION&class=ARRAY%20TO%20COLLECTION&member=)

**ARRAY TO LIST** ( *array* : Array ; *list* : Text, Integer {; *itemRefs* : Array} )

The ARRAY TO LIST command creates or replaces the hierarchical list or the choice list (created in the List editor) that is specified in *list* using the elements of the array *array.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20TO%20LIST&class=ARRAY%20TO%20LIST&member=)

**ARRAY TO SELECTION** ({ *array* : Array ; *aField* : Field {; ...(*array* : Array; *aField* : Field)}{; *} })

The **ARRAY TO SELECTION** command copies one or more arrays into a selection of records.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ARRAY%20TO%20SELECTION&class=ARRAY%20TO%20SELECTION&member=)

**ASSERT** ( *boolExpression* : Boolean {; *messageText* : Text} )

The **ASSERT** command evaluates the *boolExpression* assertion passed in parameter and, if it returns false, stops the code execution with an error message.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=ASSERT&class=ASSERT&member=)

**Abs** ( *number* : Real ) : Real

Abs returns the absolute (unsigned, positive) value of *number*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Abs&class=Abs&member=)

**Action info** ( *action* : Text {; *target* : Integer} ) : Object

The **Action info** command returns several information, including availability and status, about the defined *action* in the *target*, according to the current application context.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Action%20info&class=Action%20info&member=)

**Activated**  : Boolean

The **Activated** command (obsolete) returns **True** in a form method when the window containing the form becomes the frontmost window of the frontmost process.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Activated&class=Activated&member=)

**Active transaction** : Boolean

The **Active transaction** command returns **True** if the current process is in transaction, and this transaction is not suspended.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Active%20transaction&class=Active%20transaction&member=)

**Add to date** ( *date* : Date ; *years* : Integer ; *months* : Integer ; *days* : Integer ) : Date

The **Add to date** command adds *years*, *months,* and *days* to the date you pass in *aDate*, then returns the result.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Add%20to%20date&class=Add%20to%20date&member=)

**After**  : Boolean

**After** returns True for the After execution cycle.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=After&class=After&member=)

**Append document** ( *document* : Text {; *fileType* : Text} ) : Time

The **Append document** command does the same as thing as Open document: it opens a document on disk.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Append%20document&class=Append%20document&member=)

**Application file**  : Text

The Application file command returns the long name of the 4D executable file or application you are running.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Application%20file&class=Application%20file&member=)

**Application info** : Object

The **Application info** command returns an object providing detailed information about the active application's activity and network configuration.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Application%20info&class=Application%20info&member=)

**Application type**  : Integer

The Application type command returns a numeric value that denotes the type of 4D environment that you are running.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Application%20type&class=Application%20type&member=)

**Application version** ( {*buildNum* : Integer} {; *} ) : Text

The **Application version** command returns an encoded string value that expresses the version number of the 4D environment you are running.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Application%20version&class=Application%20version&member=)

**Arctan** ( *number* : Real ) : Real

Arctan returns the angle, expressed in radians, of the tangent *number*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Arctan&class=Arctan&member=)

**Asserted** ( *boolExpression* : Boolean {; *messageText* : Text} ) : Boolean

The **Asserted** command has an operation similar to that of the ASSERT command, with one difference in that it returns a value which is the result of the evaluation of the *boolExpression* parameter.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Asserted&class=Asserted&member=)

**Average** ( *series* : Field, Array {; *attributePath* : Text} ) : Real

**Average** returns the arithmetic mean (average) of *series*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=Average&class=Average&member=)

**BACKUP INFO** ( *selector* : Integer ; *info1* : Integer, Date ; *info2* : Time, Text )

The BACKUP INFO command gets information related to the last backup performed on the database data.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BACKUP%20INFO&class=BACKUP%20INFO&member=)

**BACKUP**

The BACKUP command starts the backup of the database using the current backup settings.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BACKUP&class=BACKUP&member=)

**BASE64 DECODE** ( *toDecode* : Text, Blob {; *decoded* : Text, Blob}{; *} )

The **BASE64 DECODE** command decodes the text or blob value coded in Base64 or Base64URL format passed in the *toDecode* parameter.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BASE64%20DECODE&class=BASE64%20DECODE&member=)

**BASE64 ENCODE** ( *toEncode* : Blob, Text {; *encoded* : Blob, Text}{; *} )

The **BASE64 ENCODE** command encodes the text or blob value passed in the *toEncode* parameter in Base64 or Base64URL format.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BASE64%20ENCODE&class=BASE64%20ENCODE&member=)

**BEEP**

The BEEP command causes the PC or Macintosh to generate a beep.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BEEP&class=BEEP&member=)

**BLOB PROPERTIES** ( *blob* : Blob ; *compressed* : Integer {; *expandedSize* : Integer {; *currentSize* : Integer}} )

The **BLOB PROPERTIES** command returns information about the BLOB *blob*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20PROPERTIES&class=BLOB%20PROPERTIES&member=)

**BLOB TO DOCUMENT** ( *document* : Text ; *blob* : Blob )

BLOB TO DOCUMENT rewrites the whole contents of *document* using the data stored in *blob*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20TO%20DOCUMENT&class=BLOB%20TO%20DOCUMENT&member=)

**BLOB TO PICTURE** ( *pictureBlob* : Blob ; *picture* : Picture {; *codec* : Text} )

The **BLOB TO PICTURE** command inserts a picture stored in a BLOB into a 4D picture variable or field, regardless its original format.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20TO%20PICTURE&class=BLOB%20TO%20PICTURE&member=)

**BLOB TO USERS** ( *users* : Blob )

The BLOB TO USERS command replaces the user accounts and groups found in the BLOB *users* in the current database.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20TO%20USERS&class=BLOB%20TO%20USERS&member=)

**BLOB TO VARIABLE** ( *blob* : Blob ; *variable* : Variable {; *offset* : Integer} )

The BLOB TO VARIABLE command rewrites the variable *variable* with the data stored within the BLOB *blob* at the byte offset (starting at zero) specified by *offset*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20TO%20VARIABLE&class=BLOB%20TO%20VARIABLE&member=)

**BLOB size** ( *blob* : Blob ) : Integer

BLOB sizereturns the size of *blob* expressed in bytes.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20size&class=BLOB%20size&member=)

**BLOB to integer** ( *blob* : Blob ; *byteOrder* : Integer {; *offset* : Variable} ) : Integer

The BLOB to integer command returns a 2-byte Integer value read from the BLOB *blob*.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20to%20integer&class=BLOB%20to%20integer&member=)

**BLOB to list** ( *blob* : Blob {; *offset* : Integer} ) : Integer

The BLOB to list command creates a new hierarchical list with the data stored within the BLOB *blob* at the byte offset (starting at zero) specified by *offset* and returns a List Reference number for that new list.

[Show documentation](https://developer.4d.com/docs/searchAPI.html?v=21R5&command=BLOB%20to%20list&class=BLOB%20to%20list&member=)

**BLOB to longint** ( *blob* : Blob ; *byteOrder* : Integer {; *offset* : Variable} ) : Integer
